claim: Each CloudWatch graph is limited to a maximum of 500 metrics and expressions, so a math expression can be added only if the graph has 499 or fewer metrics.
question: How many metrics and expressions can one CloudWatch graph use?

qualifiers.condition: Applies even if not all the metrics are displayed on the graph.

evidence.quote: Each graph is limited to using a maximum of 500 metrics and expressions, so you can add a math expression only if the graph has 499 or fewer metrics.

claim: If you omit MaxDatapoints in a GetMetricData request, the default of 100,800 data points is used before the response paginates.
question: What is the default number of data points a GetMetricData request returns before paginating?

evidence.quote: The maximum number of data points the request should return before paginating. If you omit this, the default of 100,800 is used.

note: Not found: a limit on the number of metrics per GetMetricData call; the API reference page only mentions the message 'Maximum number of allowed metrics exceeded'.

claim: A single alarm mute rule can target up to 100 alarms by alarm names.
question: How many alarms can one CloudWatch alarm mute rule target by name?

evidence.quote: A single alarm mute rule can target up to 100 alarms by alarm names.

claim: Metrics that have had no new data points in the past two weeks do not appear in the console; retrieve them with get-metric-data or get-metric-statistics.
question: Why does an old CloudWatch metric not show up in the console, and how can you still get its data?

values.display: no new data points in the past two weeks

evidence.quote: Metrics that have not had any new data points in the past two weeks do not appear in the console.

note: The same note adds that such metrics are not returned by list-metrics; the best way to retrieve them is get-metric-data or get-metric-statistics.

claim: CloudWatch Database Insights Standard Mode includes up to 7 days of detailed database and per-query metrics retention at no additional cost; beyond that, retention can be configured from 1 to 24 months.
question: How long does Database Insights Standard Mode keep metrics at no extra cost, and how far can retention be extended?

evidence.quote: Up to 7 days of detailed database and per-query metrics retention is included at no additional cost. Beyond that, retention can be configured from 1 to 24 months.

claim: On May 15, 2026 CloudWatch Logs Insights raised the number of results a query can retrieve to 100,000 (set with the LIMIT command); before that, queries were limited to 10,000 results.
question: When did Logs Insights raise the maximum number of query results, and what was the old limit?

qualifiers.condition: GetQueryResults returns up to 10,000 results per call and paginates.

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch Logs announces increased query result limits

evidence.quote: Previously, customers were limited to 10,000 results and had to split their queries into smaller time ranges to retrieve all results.

note: Only this What's New post states the new result limit; the Logs Insights guide page saved here does not. Examinable by the date rule (before 2026-07-15) but new.
